checkpoint.tensor_metadata_source: same snapshot/model.safetensors header; metadata only, no tensor values read

matrix.checkpoint_requirement: Q projection [960,960] reshapes to [B,15,S,64]; K and V [320,960] each reshape to [B,5,S,64]. Each KV head serves 3 query heads.
matrix.pinned_zeta_behavior: NonCollapsingAttention.forward requires broadcastable leading dimensions and same d_k. [B,15,S,64] and [B,5,S,64] are not broadcastable; repeat_interleave(K/V, 3, head axis) satisfies shape only.
matrix.smallest_valid_action: A Zeta scaled-dot-product GQA path must accept 15 Q heads and 5 K/V heads or define exact 3:1 KV expansion. Expansion alone is not compatibility.

matrix.checkpoint_requirement: All 290 header entries are BF16; 361821120 parameters. No lm_head tensor is present because tie_word_embeddings=true.
matrix.pinned_zeta_behavior: Attention converts Q/K/V to FP32 internally (core.py:194-201) and casts output to V dtype. RoPE computes its rotation in FP64 but returns the input dtype (positions.py:69-72). Zeta does not provide checkpoint weight loading.
matrix.smallest_valid_action: Load values only in a future authorized implementation and widen BF16 tensors to FP32. Widening preserves each stored BF16 value exactly; do not claim model weights were loaded in this investigation.

matrix.checkpoint_requirement: Requested execution precision is FP32 on CPU; parameters must be widened from BF16 before FP32 model operations.
matrix.pinned_zeta_behavior: NonCollapsingAttention selects FP32 accumulation unless any input is FP64; CPU cache stores the input dtype/device and RoPE returns input dtype.
matrix.smallest_valid_action: Keep all loaded model parameters and inference activations FP32; test CPU operator and numerical behavior without relying on BF16 execution.

matrix.checkpoint_requirement: Full head dimension 64; rope_theta=100000; rope_interleaved=false (split-half); rope_scaling=null; configured positions 0 through at most 8191.
matrix.pinned_zeta_behavior: rotary_embedding(x, positions, base, scaling, scale_factor) supports base=100000 and int64 broadcastable positions, but always rotates adjacent interleaved pairs. Optional linear/NTK scaling exists but is not requested by this checkpoint.
evidence: config.json: head_dim=64, rope_theta=100000, rope_interleaved=false, rope_scaling=null, max_position_embeddings=8192
matrix.smallest_valid_action: Within each head, permute split-half coordinates [a0..a31,b0..b31] to [a0,b0,...,a31,b31] before Zeta RoPE; use base=100000, no scaling, original absolute int64 positions. Apply identically to Q and K.

matrix.checkpoint_requirement: Per-head scores are raw QK^T/sqrt(64), followed by causal softmax and multiplication by V; Q/K vector magnitude is semantically significant.
matrix.pinned_zeta_behavior: NonCollapsingAttention.forward L2-normalizes Q and K, then uses tau*cos(Q,K) with a learned bounded temperature. Its SDPA route scales normalized Q by tau*sqrt(d_k), equivalent to cosine logits, not scaled raw dot products.
evidence: zeta_scaling_toolkit/core.py:236 and 269-275, cosine logits and SDPA path
matrix.smallest_valid_action: Change Zeta by adding an explicit scaled raw-dot-product attention implementation with GQA and causal masking. A Recall wrapper around the current normalized component cannot restore the discarded per-vector magnitudes.

matrix.checkpoint_requirement: Each of 32 layers has K and V shaped [B,5,T,64]; use absolute positions and retain all keys for exact full attention through the configured maximum of 8192 positions.
matrix.pinned_zeta_behavior: StreamingKVCache.append accepts one position per call, detaches stored tensors, returns int64 absolute positions, and retains sink positions plus the recent window. It does not interpret attention semantics.
matrix.smallest_valid_action: Use a separate cache per layer with window=8192 and sink_tokens=0 for exact retention within the checkpoint position limit; pass returned absolute positions to RoPE. Any smaller/sliding window changes the reference context.

matrix.checkpoint_requirement: 32 Llama decoder layers with pre-attention and post-attention RMSNorm, residual additions around attention and MLP, epsilon=1e-5; norm weights [960].
matrix.pinned_zeta_behavior: The pinned public API exports no Llama block, RMSNorm, or residual model runner; the installed package contains only core.py, positions.py, and exports in __init__.py.
evidence: model.safetensors header: input_layernorm.weight and post_attention_layernorm.weight [960] per layer
matrix.smallest_valid_action: Implement the checkpoint's RMSNorm and residual ordering faithfully in the Recall model adapter, or add supported model modules upstream. Do not substitute Zeta QK normalization for RMSNorm.

matrix.checkpoint_requirement: SwiGLU: gate_proj/up_proj [2560,960], down_proj [960,2560], SiLU activation, no MLP bias.
matrix.pinned_zeta_behavior: No Llama SwiGLU decoder MLP is exported by the pinned Zeta API.
matrix.smallest_valid_action: Map the three projection weights and compute down_proj(silu(gate_proj(x))*up_proj(x)) in the Llama residual path.

matrix.checkpoint_requirement: Token embedding [49152,960]; final norm [960]; tied output embedding, with no separate lm_head tensor.
matrix.pinned_zeta_behavior: No tokenizer, embedding, final normalization, or causal-LM output head is exported by the pinned Zeta API.
evidence: model.safetensors header: model.embed_tokens.weight [49152,960], model.norm.weight [960], no lm_head.weight
matrix.smallest_valid_action: Use the same embedding parameter for output logits via its transpose; avoid allocating an independent untied lm_head.

matrix.checkpoint_requirement: Validate and map all 290 header entries: two global tensors and nine tensors per each of 32 layers, preserving BF16 values and tied embedding metadata.
matrix.pinned_zeta_behavior: No from_pretrained, safetensors loader, Llama model class, or checkpoint mapping API is exposed in the pinned package.
evidence: zeta package inventory at pinned version: __init__.py, core.py, positions.py, py.typed
matrix.smallest_valid_action: Implement a metadata-first Recall loader with exact name/shape/dtype coverage checks; only load tensor values after the attention blocker and 6144 MiB memory preflight are cleared.

decision.reason: A Recall adapter can bridge shape/layout and compose model plumbing, but cannot preserve checkpoint attention semantics through pinned NonCollapsingAttention.
